name: Professor Laurel
dialogue: Study every Pokémon you meet, and take these Potions for the road.
post_dialogue: Your journey has only just begun.
The northern road leads toward Azure City.

name: Mira
dialogue: Bluebell is small, but every road in the Beta Region connects back to someone.
Try talking to people from the direction you're facing.

name: Avery
dialogue: There you are! I've been training on Route 1.
Let's see which of us understands our partner better!
post_dialogue: I'll train harder before we meet again.

name: Ranger Rowan
dialogue: A careful trainer watches the terrain and the opponent.
Show me how you handle a forest battle!
post_dialogue: Your team moves confidently through the forest.

name: Tess
dialogue: I carry the basics every new trainer needs.
post_dialogue: Come back whenever you need supplies.

name: Leader Marina
dialogue: I am Marina, Azure City's first Gym Leader.
Strong currents reward trainers who plan ahead. Challenge me!
post_dialogue: The Current Badge proves your command of momentum.
